description: This file contains unit tests for the EmailService implementation in the book project. It tests both sending a simple email message and sending an email with a Thymeleaf template, verifying the email content and recipients.

classes.name: EmailServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for EmailServiceImpl, testing email sending functionalities including simple message and Thymeleaf templated message.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, sets sample message details, and creates an instance of EmailServiceImpl with required dependencies.

methods.name: GivenRecipientSubjectBody_WhenSendSimpleMessage_ThenSendMessage
methods.description: Tests sending a simple email message and verifies the received email content, recipient, and subject.

methods.name: GivenRecipientSubjectBody_WhenSendMessageUsingThymeleafTemplate_ThenSendMessage
methods.description: Tests sending an email message rendered with a Thymeleaf template and verifies the email content, recipient, and subject.
